title: Stonewatch
wikitext:
[[Image:Stonewatch.jpg|thumb|300px|Stonewatch]]
'''Stonewatch''' is the common name of the battlestation in central [[Redridge Mountains]]. It includes both the easily defensible [[Stonewatch Keep]] and the armored [[Stonewatch Tower]], with the [[Stonewatch Falls]] cascading down a cliff face below it. The entirety of Stonewatch has fallen into the hands of the [[Blackrock Clan|Blackrock]] clan under the leadership of their warchief [[Gath'Ilzogg]], and his chief lieutenant, [[Tharil'zun]].
